say:1:1620619001:0.text: ... He's been through a lot, hasn't he?
say:1:1620619001:0.source_cn: 唉……这位老师的经历真够坎坷的。

say:2:1620619002:0.text: I think he meant well. He just went too far trying to make sure his students succeeded.
say:2:1620619002:0.source_cn: 也许他只是想让学生有个好未来，只是……方法粗暴了点。

say:3:1620619003:0.text: Went too far? What makes you say that?
say:3:1620619003:0.source_cn: 粗暴？为什么你们会这么觉得？

say:4:1620619004:0.text: Didn't you hear what he said? He's clearly full of regret. He knows he pushed too hard.
say:4:1620619004:0.source_cn: 当然啊，就连他自己，不也这么承认了吗？

say:5:1620619005:0.text: But isn't it a professor's job to push their students? To challenge them?
say:5:1620619005:0.source_cn: 我不太明白。难道督促学生，不正是老师的职责吗？

say:6:1620619006:0.text: That's just it, Loran. Can I ask you something? Why did you want to become a mage in the first place?
say:6:1620619006:0.source_cn: 啧啧，洛兰，其实我一直想问——你是为了什么才想当魔法师的？

say:8:1620619008:0.text: There's always a reason. You don't study magic for no reason, just like you don't eat for no reason.
say:8:1620619008:0.source_cn: 当然得有个理由吧，就像饿了会吃饭，渴了会喝水一样。

say:10:1620619010:0.text: For me, it started with an old mage in my village.
say:10:1620619010:0.source_cn: 比如说，我的魔法启蒙，是镇上的一位魔法师老奶奶教的。

say:11:1620619011:0.text: The town had constant droughts, but her magic always brought gentle rain. She saved the crops, year after year.
say:11:1620619011:0.source_cn: 那会儿我们镇老是闹旱灾，她的魔法总能带来温润的小雨，救...

say:12:1620619012:0.text: What truly lit that fire in me was something she once said: <style="highlight">"Magic is just a tool. It sparks hope, and carries it forward."</style>
say:12:1620619012:0.source_cn: 让我真正对魔法燃起兴趣的，是她对我说的——<style...

say:13:1620619013:0.text: Ever since then, I've been learning water magic, hoping that one day, I can help others like she did.
say:13:1620619013:0.source_cn: 就因为这句话，我才一直坚持学水魔法，希望有一天能像她那...

say:14:1620619014:0.text: That's why I study. Knowledge has to serve a purpose. Without that, all those theories don't mean a thing.
say:14:1620619014:0.source_cn: 所以学术对我来说是为了实现目标而存在的，不然就是本末倒置。

say:15:1620619015:0.text: I've never thought about it that way. I just enjoy learning. I never asked myself what for.
say:15:1620619015:0.source_cn: 我从未想过这些……我只是喜欢研究学术，从没想过要用它干什么。

say:17:1620619016:0.text: Just as Loran finishes speaking, a sudden burst of wingbeats echoes down the hallway.
say:17:1620619016:0.source_cn: 洛兰话音未落，楼道深处忽然传来一阵急促的扑翼声。
say:17:1620619016:0.male: Just as Loran finishes speaking, a sudden burst of wingbeats echoes down the hallway.
say:17:1620619016:0.female: Just as Loran finishes speaking, a sudden burst of wingbeats echoes down the hallway.

say:18:1620619017:0.text: In the next second, dozens of magic books burst from the shadows, swarming toward you like a living tide.
say:18:1620619017:0.source_cn: 无数魔法书从阴影中冲出，像潮水般扑向你们——
say:18:1620619017:0.male: In the next second, dozens of magic books burst from the shadows, swarming toward you like a living tide.
say:18:1620619017:0.female: In the next second, dozens of magic books burst from the shadows, swarming toward you like a living tide.

say:19:1620619018:0.text: The books... there's so many! They've gone completely mad!
say:19:1620619018:0.source_cn: 一大群魔法书！它们发疯了！
